# f-04 receipt: corpus/ arXiv census and agent-swarm reading list

Item f-04, 2026-09-28. Deliverable: `corpus-arxiv-list.md` in this directory (top-25 agent-swarm reading list). This file is the census receipt.

## Commands run and their outputs

1. Scan (script `f04_scan.py` run with `.venv/Scripts/python.exe`, working tree of this repo):
   - regex `arXiv[: ]?(\d{4}).(\d{4,5})` over every readable file under `corpus/` (binary extensions skipped, utf-8 errors-ignore)
   - output: files_scanned 71590, bytes_scanned 5601766888, files_with_hits 88, total_matches 1959, strict_dot_matches 1959 (every match was the dotted form), unique_ids_normalized 335, read_errors 0
   - top corpus IDs by hit count: 2607.28956 (67), 2607.00918 (47), 2501.12948 (44), 2305.14325 (33), 2603.25158 (33), 2506.19143 (33), 2304.03442 (24), 2608.10218 (24), 2608.23651 (24), 2308.09687 (22)
   - hits concentrate in: `corpus/oral_history/seat_pools/codex_sessions/...` (85 distinct IDs in one 2026-08-30 rollout), grok_sessions updates/chat/rewind files (45/45/41), `corpus/oral_history/marathon_body/marathon_25fbcaab_20260815_20260820.jsonl` (40), `corpus/library/jev_steal_library/sovereign_ai_fleet_consolidated_bibliography (2).md` (39), `corpus/library/interference-search/paper/references.bib` (25)
2. Fetch (script `f04_fetch.py`): batches of 40 against `https://export.arxiv.org/api/query?id_list=...&max_results=40` (arxiv.org's own export API; Atom parsed for title, authors, summary, categories, dates), 3s spacing, per-ID canonical zero-padded 5-digit query form, individual retries with corpus-raw forms for the 3 odd IDs.
   - final output: requested 335, resolved 335, unresolved 0, net_errors 0
3. Spot checks during the run: `curl -o /dev/null -w %{http_code}` gave export_api 200, abs_page (arxiv.org/abs/2305.14325) 200, plain http 301.

## Two fetch failures diagnosed and fixed this run (kept because they will bite the next census)

1. Custom User-Agent rejected: first fetch run used UA `mag-census-f04/0.1 (local corpus scan; contact: operator)` and every request returned HTTP 400 Bad Request; A/B in-session showed the same URLs return 200 with the default UA or a curl UA. Fix: omit the header.
2. One malformed ID poisons the batch: my first normalization produced keys like `1201.749` (integer-normalized from `1201.0749`, 3-digit suffix) and export.arxiv.org answers the whole `id_list` batch with HTTP 400 when any ID is malformed, not with a per-ID error entry. Fix: query canonical zero-padded 5-digit forms; only the 3 four-digit corpus forms needed raw-form retries. Verified: `id_list=1201.749,1402.2295,1406.2294` -> 400 while `id_list=2305.14325,2203.14465` -> 200.

## Deliverable

- `corpus-arxiv-list.md`: 25 entries ranked for agent-swarm research (multi-agent frameworks, emergent swarm dynamics and pathology, collective learning, swarm-serving infrastructure, long-horizon evaluation), each with title, first author, year, primary category, corpus hit count, corpus source file and line, link, and a relevance note grounded in the fetched abstract; plus a 10-entry shortlist and coverage notes.
